messages:
taylor: flagging something odd from partner CI mirror: found a KMS-wrapped ciphertext blob inside uploaded tarball at s3://partner-ci-mirror/2026-03-21/onboard.tgz (file: payload/wrapped.token.enc). moving to quarantine and looping sec.

samir: thanks. header peek (redacted) please and which KMS key is referenced? also who had write access to that prefix?

taylor: header shows `kms: gcp_kms_v1 | projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/onboard/cryptoKeys/onboard-wrap | v1` (truncated). ACLs: partner-ci role (put/get), build-bots (read), infra svc acc (read).

yasmin: auto-create incident INC-2026-096. marking P2. immediate checklist: quarantine copy, export object access logs (30d), query KMS decrypt audit for onboard-wrap.

sec-bot: [AUTO] rule=artifact_kms_detected; confidence=0.84; recommendation=quarantine+rotate

samir: pulling CloudAudit for Decrypt calls now: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" AND protoPayload.request.name:"projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/onboard/cryptoKeys/onboard-wrap"' --limit 200`

taylor: quarantine copy done to secure project: gs://sec-quarantine/6328007777-onboard.tgz. checksum sha256=dd14c3... saved in INC-2026-096. not unpacking outside secure env.

yasmin: RBAC mitigation: propose temporary scoped deny of storage.objects.get on that prefix for partner-ci principal. I'll draft policy with 4hr TTL. we should also plan a rekey.

samir: quick audit shows one Decrypt call 5 days ago by `serviceAccount:partner-runner@partners.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. no other principals. blast radius limited to partner CI and our onboarding svcacct.

taylor: since our CMK appears referenced, plan: (1) create new key version, (2) disable decrypt on old version for non-infra principals, (3) rewrap quarantined blobs in secure project, (4) ask partner to rotate any inner credentials.

yasmin: agree. I'll schedule the RBAC apply at 02:00-03:00 PT to minimize disruption; include rollback steps. posting RBAC patch in the ticket.

samir: I'll prepare the rewrap script to run in secure CI: decrypt with old key in locked env, then encrypt with new key version and write to sec-quarantine; will require KMS admin perms.

taylor: partner outreach draft: "We found a wrapped credential in your onboarding artifact that references a Redwood-managed KMS key. We've quarantined the object and are rotating access. Please rotate any secrets in that artifact and confirm." sending via partner-ops.

yasmin: sec-bot appended checklist to INC-2026-096: export-logs, quarantine-copy, create-key-version, revoke-old-decrypt, rewrap-sweep, partner-notify, postmortem.

taylor: assigning: taylor -> quarantine + partner comms; samir -> logs + rewrap tooling; yasmin -> RBAC patch + incident lead. target: mitigations by EOD, rewrap sweep within 24h.

yasmin: will publish final update to INC-2026-096 after RBAC applied. thanks team. :thumbsup:
